In January 2024, what I at first thought was another downward spiral of sleep paralysis, turned out to be a terrifying experience. Thinking it may be similar to May 29, 2021, I opened my eyes. It was completely dark, meaning any light from electronic chargers and faint light from the window, were not present. Also missing was the sensation of my bed. Through the absolute darkness I could see three columns of grayish smoke/fog entities. Somehow the pitch black did not swallow them up. The energy from them was not neutral like the column of grayish smoke in 2021. Instead, fear permeated my body as I attempted to wake up or make them disappear. All three were on the left side on my bed, the only side which you can get on and off of. The right side and head of the bed are against the wall, in a corner. As I continued my attempts to wake up or admonish them, their energy turned malignant, cruel. I'd rise almost to consciousness several times. Each time was met with a violent push down on my sternum. I don't know how long it was before something, like a blast of direct energy started pushing me down on my sternum, as if it was making the letter U with my body. Each time I was pushed down, I was subsequently pushed up violently, an inverted U shape. The pushing me up and down felt like I was a basketball. My middle back and midsection were pummeled relentlessly. There were no hands or other body parts doing this. Only pure energy. It hurt in the sense that I had no control. Zero. I felt some physical pain that I wasn't familiar with. I live with pain every day and this experience was nothing like it. During the time I was being dribbled, warped, pushed and pulled, I sensed a sadistic pleasure from whatever was causing this torture. I wasn't able to open my eyes, nor had any reference point of where it was taking place. Eventually, it stopped. The stop was abrupt, similar to walking into a wall. When I came to, if that's what it should be called, a strange and extremely uncomfortable feeling came over me. I felt remnants of pain, had tears in my eyes and felt fear and helplessness within me. The following week, the unusual pain stayed with me, became a back drop to my physical pain. The mere thought of what had happened would and continues to create a sense of paranoia in me. Within a few weeks of the torture game, I had another experience brought on by sleep paralysis I assume. It was different. Only one column of an entity next to my bed. I stared up at it, frozen in fear. It did nothing. It was either examining me or taunting me. When I was allowed to rise back to consciousness, I was angry. I yelled some obscenities to what appeared to be, an empty room, my bedroom/office.

I have obtained footage of multiple UFO/UAP's in the sky at night. I have multiple videos saved, some more compelling evidence I have not been able to capture because of the sudden nature of the phenomenon. They do not seem to be commercial airplanes, no green or red lights, no blinking lights, they do not seem to be satellites, they are not comets, meteors, or meteorites, I have seen all of the above many times as I am an avid gazer of the night sky, they all fall in contrast with these UFO's/UAP's the only other logical explanation I can give might be the possibility of military aircraft, maybe afterburners, maybe advanced military aircraft, but some of my other sightings completely dismiss that possibility (I will go into detail as to why that is). They all look like yellow orange orbs traveling at very high rates of speed. I see them almost every night, I have seen them at varying distances, from approximately 35,000 - 45,000 ft, and as low as approximately 500 - 1000 ft. They never give off any sound or noise, even the ones that fly relatively close to the ground, they are always dead silent. If they were fighter jets, you would definitely hear it. Many of them fly across the sky for many minutes and slowly begin to fade away until they completely vanish, some have flown right overhead at close proximity of the ground and on multiple occasions, their orange glow has intensified for a few seconds, they dim back down, travel a bit longer and then fade away, on one occasion I looked up at what I believed to be a star, after 10 seconds of gazing at what I believed to be a star, the star moved from its stationary/ hovering position to a C shape and the yellow-orange glow from the object vanished in a matter of seconds. I have had a few instances where individuals have been outside with me and have witnessed some of the more compelling sightings and they cannot describe what it could be. Last night I saw multiple orbs, one of them was flying in the direction of New York City, traveling from SW to NE, I was observing it for approximately 2-3 minutes. it was flying at the same altitude as a commercial airliner, it was flying head on towards the airplane and as it neared the airliner, it faded away. I have seen many, many sightings throughout my life. One of the Stanger sightings I have seen was a bluish green disc shaped orb about the size of school bus that flew over me and my 2 other friends at about 100 ft above, it was the dead of night in the Florida everglades, about 5 years ago. (Please contact me directly to obtain the footage)
